name: project
text: `claude -p --output-format json` prints one result object whose `result` is the agent's last message when `is_error` is false and the CLI's own error when it is true (measured, CLI 2.1.332; exit 1 on errors); the message sits after usage and modelUsage, beyond the first 200 characters of the line. Anything that classifies agent logs reads `is_error` before any text.
